description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
The device holds one lock over every use of the driver's pipeline cache and writes it only where it holds pipelines past its header, by the one rule its answer gives, and e3d says what it found where it finds no session.
The pipelines' file test asks the device whether its driver's cache holds pipelines, as lavapipe's holds none, and the device says once in the log that it writes none.
The Linux job runs the suite in order and the suite shuffled by the day's seed as two jobs at once, each held to 120 minutes, where one job ran both after each other in 141 of its 150.
Global illumination is a project of its own on the renderer, 3DEngine.GlobalIllumination, its renderer, stages, reference, view, commands and plugin moved there, and the engine's package depends on it as on its other areas.
Global illumination is added to the renderer by a plugin of its own, a part the renderer starts that loads its shaders, sets its renderers and adds its nodes, so a program built without it holds none of it.
The HDR frame, the render targets and the lighting buffer reach global illumination through an interface its renderer is set in the render world under, rather than through the renderer.
Global illumination's binding stands apart from its renderer, the probes' and the screen's images, their making and what the quality and the field give alone, which the passes that read it now take.
The cache command lists and clears the engine's caches, the pipelines are written after quiet frames as well as at the end, and both caches are bounded by age and by size.
The exposure that follows the scene keeps its adapted value in floats of four bytes, so it comes to rest at the point it meters whatever the frames' pace.
SetSceneFieldAhead holds the scene's field ahead of the camera along its view by widths of its finest cascade, so no program counts the field's cells.
The day sky scales the sun's strength outside the air by its height where SkyDay.SunByHeight asks, so scenes_sponza sets its sun once and an hour after.
The flat API decodes a channel or a color from sRGB to its light and encodes it back, over one curve in Core that the engine's eleven hand-written copies now call.
The exposure that follows the scene takes its bounds in EV at ISO 100, the bloom drawn is chosen by its kind with a scatter from 0 to 1, lift, gamma and gain take three numbers, and scenes_sponza writes its grade, bloom and metering as numbers.
title: 3DEngine
